sheets.reading_notes: Specifications sheet embedded in the drawing set. Contains full text of specification sections for Hydronic Pumps and Domestic Water Piping (Sec. 22 11 16). McPherson Design Group (Structural Engineers) listed in title block alongside BFA. Confirms plumbing and hydronic systems scope. References cross-sections for wiring per 260519 and 260526. Sheet date 8-23-21.

sheets.title: Enlarged Fountain Plan — Primary Plumbing Layout
sheets.reading_notes: Plan of Crawford Circle roundabout island at 1/8"=1'-0" scale. Circular fountain island with inner and outer distribution manifolds (Type K flexible copper piping). Multiple numbered spray nozzle locations (Types 1-6 typical). Existing electrical vault shown. Construction notes: contractor to engage fountain consultant to design entire system; sand filter pump, ventilation, main circulation pump, sump pump, double-check valve backflow preventer, water meter, and water fill piping per DBVB vault; Type K rigid copper piping to spray nozzles; nozzles produce spray 10'-0" and 4'-0" high; ball valve manifold to control spray height; wailer line scuppers. Street labels confirm Crawford Circle / Crawford Street / Bart Street. BFA seal in title block.

sheets.title: Cut Sheets
sheets.reading_notes: Product cut sheets for: (1) DBVB-Series Direct Burial Vault System — fully pre-assembled RCF80 PVC heated vault for fountain pumping and electrical controls with stainless steel top-access grates; (2) GEY-Series Geyser Nozzle — machined cast-bronze with female-threaded inlet, various heights/flow rates; (3) VEN-Series Vee Nozzle — thin-blade V-shaped fan spray, one-piece brass construction, water-level-independent, NPT connection. Notes instruct contractor to engage fountain consultant for entire system design and proper equipment per manufacturer's recommendations.

sheets.title: Details
sheets.reading_notes: Additional product cut sheets and details: Ball Valve (Brass) for fountain water system flow regulation; CWL-002WD Wall Mounted Overflow/Sensor — combined overflow drain and water-level sensor, concealed behind face plate; FAS-08 Anti-Vortex/Diverter Plate and Sump — heavy-duty sump with 2" threaded side connections, cast bronze anti-vortex/diverter plate, requires 4" thick concrete around sump body; FDF-Series Floor Drain Fitting with plug — flush-mount, in-pool connection; FSK-150J Front Access Skimmer (2 of 2 sheets) — heavy-duty ABS housing with removable trash basket and lid, for fountain surface debris collection. All fountain equipment from Fountain People, Inc. (San Marcos, TX).
